devices.label: iPhone 15 Pro smartphone
devices.description: Apple flagship with a 5G sub-6 GHz / mmWave modem and Wi-Fi 6E: 802.11ax on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO at up to 2.4 Gbps per band.

devices.label: iPhone 16 smartphone
devices.description: 5G sub-6 GHz / mmWave modem with Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO; Apple caps EHT channels at 160 MHz, so peak PHY is about 2.4 Gbps.

devices.label: Samsung Galaxy S24 smartphone
devices.description: Compact Samsung flagship with a 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, HE160, 1024-QAM) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO; Wi-Fi 7 is disabled on the base S24.

devices.label: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra smartphone
devices.description: 5G sub-6 GHz modem with Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), 320 MHz EHT channels and 4096-QAM over 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO at up to about 5.8 Gbps.

devices.label: Google Pixel 8 smartphone
devices.description: Tensor G3 phone with a 5G sub-6 GHz / mmWave modem and Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO; Japan units are Wi-Fi 6E and TW/SG/IN units dual-band Wi-Fi 6.

devices.label: Google Pixel 8a smartphone
devices.description: Mid-range Tensor G3 phone with a 5G sub-6 GHz / mmWave modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, HE80) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO, so peak PHY is about 1.2 Gbps.

devices.label: OnePlus 12 smartphone
devices.description: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 flagship with a 5G modem and Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) plus Wi-Fi 6E over 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO at up to about 5.8 Gbps.

devices.label: Xiaomi 14 smartphone
devices.description: Compact Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 flagship with a 5G modem and Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) across 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO, MLO peaks around 3.6 Gbps.

devices.label: Nothing Phone (2) smartphone
devices.description: Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 phone with a 5G modem and dual-band Wi-Fi 6 only (802.11ax, 2.4 and 5 GHz, 2x2 MIMO); it has no 6 GHz radio, so no Wi-Fi 6E or 7.

devices.label: Fairphone 5 smartphone
devices.description: Repairable QCM6490 phone with a 5G modem (up to 2.3 Gbps) and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO.

devices.label: Sony Xperia 1 V smartphone
devices.description: Sony flagship with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO.

devices.label: Motorola Edge 50 smartphone
devices.description: Mid-range Motorola with a Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO.

devices.label: iPad Air 11-inch (M2) tablet
devices.description: M2 tablet with an optional 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2 MIMO) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz; it tops out at 6E with no Wi-Fi 7 radio.

devices.label: iPad Pro 11-inch (M4) tablet
devices.description: M4 pro tablet with an optional 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2 MIMO) across 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, with simultaneous dual-band operation.

devices.label: Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 tablet
devices.description: Android tablet with an optional 5G sub-6 GHz modem and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, HE160, 1024-QAM) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO at up to 2.4 Gbps.

devices.label: Microsoft Surface Pro 10 tablet
devices.description: Windows 2-in-1: the Wi-Fi-only SKU has Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) and the Wi-Fi+5G SKU adds Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) alongside a 5G sub-6 GHz modem, both on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz.
